answer_sheet.Which section to retain: Keep the first five seconds of the existing eight-second clip; remove only the final three seconds.
answer_sheet.Playback speed and transitions: Keep the original playback speed. Do not add fades or transitions.

must_haves: The final video lasts five seconds.
Its opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond, with a fixed camera and soft morning light. Silent, no text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any generation credits.**

Your requested setup is **8 seconds, widescreen 16:9, silent, at 480p**—using a free-plan video model such as LTX 2.5.

**I can’t give you a verified credit quote yet:** the connected tools don’t expose an account/balance check or a price estimator. I won’t start a job just to discover the charge.

Ways to reduce the cost:
- **Shorter:** try a **3–4-second clip** instead of 8 seconds. This should reduce duration-based charges, though I can’t verify the exact savings.
- **Smaller:** **480p is the lowest supported resolution for your available video models.**
- **Static alternative:** a single pond-and-boat image avoids video generation, but won’t have drifting motion.

The prompt is ready:
> Fixed-camera wide shot of a small folded paper boat drifting slowly across a calm pond in soft morning light. Gentle ripples, natural reflections, quiet minimalist composition. No camera movement, no cuts, no text or logos. Silent.

For a firm cost, check Magic Hour’s generation screen for the **LTX 2.5, 480p, silent** quote at 8 seconds and at 4 seconds **before confirming generation**. If you share those quotes, I can help compare them.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

dialog.agent:
Do you mean **a single still image**, or **the cheapest moving video—a 3-second, silent, 480p clip**? The still image is the lowest-cost alternative I listed, but it won’t show the boat drifting.

I still can’t verify the exact credit charge with the connected tools, so nothing has run yet.
